narr: Supercells developed along a front and produced hail, strong winds and some flash flooding during the afternoon and evening of 5/30.
ev: Report of 3 to 4 inches of water over Highway K9 in two locations approximately half a mile apart east of Whiting.
lsr: REPORT OF WATER 3 TO 4 INCHES DEEP OVER K9 HIGHWAY IN TWO LOCATIONS APPROXIMATELY HALF A MILE APART EAST OF WHITING.
